info.title: Find a Doc, Japan
info.description: Public directory of clinics and healthcare professionals in Japan. Directory records are served as GraphQL at https://api.findadoc.jp. The same records are available to agents through the MCP server at https://mcp.findadoc.jp/mcp, whose REST wrappers are described by https://mcp.findadoc.jp/openapi.yaml.

servers.description: GraphQL. POST a query. Public reads need no account.
MCP streamable HTTP at /mcp, OpenAPI at /openapi.yaml
